title: Spacing Shared Household Food Shipments on Tailwise Autoship for the Pets that Stay
content:
**Household usage method — shared household food Autoship under Tailwise Autoship**

1. **The pet that leaves** is counted at the household's usage of the six months before the last six months: the units of the subscription's scheduled shipments charged between six and twelve months ago, divided by 26 weeks.
2. **The household's current usage** is the units of the subscription's scheduled shipments charged in the last twelve months, divided by 52 weeks.
3. **The pets that stay** use the household's current usage less the leaving pet's usage, and one unit lasts them 7 divided by that weekly usage, in days.
4. **Days between shipments.** The days between shared household food shipments are the subscription's units per shipment multiplied by the days one unit lasts the pets that stay.
5. **Weeks between shipments.** The weeks between shipments are those days divided by 7, rounded down to a whole week, and never fewer than the program's shortest frequency nor more than its longest frequency.

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months. Only scheduled shipments count in items 1 and 2; ship-now shipments do not.

## Worked example (hypothetical subscription, units per shipment 2, frequency range taken as 1 to 26 weeks)

| Quantity | Figure |
|---|---|
| Units of scheduled shipments charged in the last twelve months | 78 |
| of which charged between six and twelve months ago | 26 |
| Leaving pet's usage: 26 divided by 26 weeks | 1.0 unit a week |
| Household's current usage: 78 divided by 52 weeks | 1.5 units a week |
| Pets that stay: 1.5 less 1.0 | 0.5 unit a week |
| Days one unit lasts them: 7 divided by 0.5 | 14 days |
| Days between shipments: 2 units multiplied by 14 days | 28 days |
| Weeks: 28 divided by 7, rounded down | 4 weeks |
